steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each request is placed by its priority, and a request past its deadline is flagged.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Deadline already passed
findings.fix: Tell the requester the deadline has passed and act now

findings.title: Urgent request with no reason
findings.fix: Give the reason or lower the priority

outcome.notChecked: Whether the request has legal merit.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] req-l303.md:12  Deadline already passed.
       Fix: Tell the requester the deadline has passed and act now.
[medium] req-l305.md:19  Urgent request with no reason.
       Fix: Give the reason or lower the priority.
[low] req-l306.md:26  Request with no owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner.
Not checked: Whether the request has legal merit.
pros: Checks a request with no ask, an urgent request with no reason, and a request with a deadline that has already passed.
cons: Not checked: Whether the request has legal merit.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-legal-adhoc-triage skill on the records for this review.
